title.en: Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists

desc.zh: 从逐行选数推导最小堆，观察最小覆盖区间如何收紧。
desc.en: Derive a min-heap scan by selecting one value per row and discarding dominated choices.

complexity: O(N log(k+1)) time; O(k) auxiliary space, where N is the total number of elements

concepts.name: Minimum-frontier range scan
concepts.description: Advance the smallest selected row value while maintaining the largest selected value.
